messages:
alex: Heads-up — after the heuristic tweak rolled yesterday (merge_hold_ms=4 -> 1, token_target=24 -> 12) we saw a ~3x p50 increase on the small-req route.
maya: saw it on staging too? or only prod? :eyes:
alex: prod only, started ~08:14 UTC. quick graph: p50 jumped 28ms -> 90ms for requests < 64 tokens.
chris: linking traces — a lot of requests are getting no coalesced batch, hitting kernel fallback. i can share flamegraphs.
alex: paste of the slow path log snippet:
```
[2026-06-10T08:14:12Z] request-id=abc123 wait_ms=18 merged=false tokens=12 route=small-kv kernel=slow_kernel_v2
[2026-06-10T08:14:12Z] kernel_select: selected slow_kernel_v2 because batch_shape!=aligned
```
maya: interesting — kernel_select flipping to slow_kernel usually means batch shapes are degenerate (singletons) and the fast kernel's vectorized path can't be used.
sophia: could token_target decrease be starving batch formation? fewer tokens target -> earlier flush -> more singletons.
jamal: checked KV cache hit% around the same time — small drop from 98% -> 92% which increased prefill latency.
alex: timeline: heuristic roll 07:58 UTC; small route latency spike starts 08:14; sustained for ~40m; throughput slightly down.
maya: i ran a microprofile on a repro cluster, attached summary:
```
continuous-batcher: avg wait 9.8ms -> 3.2ms (after tweak)
batch-formation: singletons% 4% -> 26%
kernel-fallbacks: 12/s -> 56/s
kv-prefetch-latency: p95 3.2ms -> 7.8ms
```
chris: so lower wait_ms reduces batching window but increased singletons; combined with KV prefetch jitter caused more misses and forced slow kernel.
alex: deploy-bot: rollout "heuristic-small-window" completed at 07:58:01 UTC :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: change set: {"merge_hold_ms":1, "token_target":12}
maya: quick check — is the fallback decision based on batch size OR shape? We have a shape threshold to pick fast kernel, if batch has >1 seq and similar lengths.
sophia: we also have an affinity heuristic that tries to coalesce by route+kv_key; if token_target is low then coalescing windows rarely overlap.
jamal: KV cache churn contribution: reduced cache reuse because smaller batches had less contiguous prefix reuse. eviction rate ticked up.
alex: repro commands i used (local perf harness):
```
./perf_client --profile small --qps 250 --avg_tokens 14 --heuristic merge_hold_ms=1,token_target=12
```
maya: proposed rollback to merge_hold_ms=4 and token_target=24 for small-route only, or set merge_hold_ms=2 as intermediate.
chris: can we hotfix kernel selection to be less strict (allow fast kernel for 1-item batches if prefix cached)? risk: vectorized path slower on some shapes.
sophia: alternative: increase kv-prefetch concurrency to reduce prefill latency; but that's infra-heavy.
jamal: short-term: I'll flip small-route params back and monitor. also adding an alert for singleton% > 15% so we catch next time.
alex: +1 to rollback small-route. I'll coordinate the rollback.
maya: after rollback to merge_hold_ms=4 on canary we should run the perf_client repro to confirm p50 returns.
chris: follow-up tasks:
- revert small-route heuristic (jamal) [in progress]
- add singleton% metric + alert (sophia)
- add small-route canary checks to rollout pipeline (alex)
- experiment: loosen kernel-select shape threshold and run AB (maya/chris)
alex: thanks everyone. i'll post results when rollback is live.
jamal: rollback applied at 08:45 UTC to 10% of capacity, watching metrics now.
maya: canary p50 back to ~30ms after rollback in canary, looks promising.
alex: rolling to 100% now.
deploy-bot: rollout "heuristic-small-window" reverted at 08:58:04 UTC :white_check_mark:
alex: prod p50 trending back down to baseline. will follow-up with a short postmortem doc.
sophia: noted root cause: overly aggressive token_target reduction caused fragmentation -> singleton batches -> kernel fallback + KV churn. actionable: adjust default token_target step-down and add canary checks.
chris: also add a perf test for kernel-fallback frequency as part of pre-rollout suite.
alex: closing thread for now. thanks! :pray:
